# LaraNode

> LaraNode is a Laravel-inspired Node.js framework built on top of Express.js. It brings the elegant developer experience of Laravel to the Node.js ecosystem with a TypeScript-first, modular design — featuring an IoC container, service providers, Eloquent-style ORM, expressive routing, JWT auth, validation, caching, queues, events, mail, an Artisan CLI, plus Horizon and Telescope dashboards.

LaraNode is organized as a monorepo of 16+ focused `@lara-node/*` packages you can use independently or together. It targets Node.js 20+ with TypeScript 5+, uses decorators and reflect-metadata, and supports both MySQL and MongoDB.

**Key conventions:**
- Service providers register and boot services in a defined order (`ConfigServiceProvider` → `MiddlewareServiceProvider` → `RouteServiceProvider`)
- Configuration uses dot-notation `config('mail.default')` accessor
- Middleware aliases (`auth`, `can:perm`, `role:admin`) are registered centrally in `MiddlewareServiceProvider`
- The `pnpm create lara-node my-api` CLI scaffolds a complete application

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](/guide/introduction): Why LaraNode, philosophy, core concepts overview, package ecosystem
- [Getting Started](/guide/getting-started): Quick start using `create-laranode`, manual setup walkthrough, CLI basics
- [Installation](/guide/installation): Install packages individually, peer dependencies, TypeScript and environment setup
- [Project Structure](/guide/project-structure): Standard `src/app`, `src/bootstrap`, `src/config`, `src/database`, `src/routes` layout
- [Configuration](/guide/configuration): File-based configs in `src/config/`, env vars, `config()`/`setConfig()`/`hasConfig()` helpers

## Fundamentals

- [Service Providers](/guide/service-providers): `register()` vs `boot()`, `MiddlewareServiceProvider`, `@Provider()` auto-discovery, lifecycle hooks
- [Dependency Injection](/guide/dependency-injection): IoC container, `bind`/`singleton`/`instance`/`alias`, `@Injectable()`, automatic resolution, contextual bindings
- [Middleware](/guide/middleware): Creating middleware classes, global/group/route middleware, priority, terminable middleware, parameters (`throttle:60,1`)
- [Facades](/guide/facades): Static-like access (`Cache`, `DB`, `Mail`, `Broadcast`, `RateLimiter`), how they proxy container resolutions

## Core Package — `@lara-node/core`

- [Overview](/packages/core): IoC container, Application bootstrap, service providers, middleware stack, configuration system
- [Container](/packages/core/container): `Container` class, `bind()`/`singleton()`/`instance()`/`alias()`/`make()`/`app()`/`resolving()`
- [Application](/packages/core/application): Express wrapper, registering providers, `boot()`, `listen()`, global middleware, lifecycle hooks
- [Service Providers](/packages/core/service-providers): `ServiceProvider` base class, `this.app`, `MiddlewareServiceProvider`, registration helpers
- [Configuration](/packages/core/config): `config()`/`setConfig()`/`hasConfig()`/`allConfig()`, dot notation, loading from files
- [Form Request](/packages/core/request): `FormRequest` class, auto-validation via TypeScript metadata, `validated()`/`safe()`/`errors()`, authorization, custom messages

## Database — `@lara-node/db`

- [Overview](/packages/db): Eloquent-inspired ORM, MySQL & MongoDB, relationships, query builder, migrations, traits, observers
- [Models](/packages/db/models): Defining models, fillable/guarded/hidden, accessors/mutators, casts, CRUD operations
- [Query Builder](/packages/db/query-builder): `where`, `orWhere`, `whereIn`, joins, ordering, pagination, chunking, cursor, `whereHas`, soft delete scopes
- [Relationships](/packages/db/relationships): `hasOne`, `hasMany`, `belongsTo`, `belongsToMany`, `hasOneThrough`, `hasManyThrough`, eager loading, pivot data
- [Migrations](/packages/db/migrations): Schema builder, column types, modifiers, foreign keys, `make:migration`, `migrate:fresh`/`migrate:rollback`
- [Seeders](/packages/db/seeders): Writing seeders, model factories, `db:seed`, `DatabaseSeeder` orchestrator, `db:wipe`
- [Traits](/packages/db/traits): `SoftDeletes`, `Timestamps`, `Sluggable`, `Sortable`, `Searchable`, `Cacheable` — applied via `@use()`
- [Observers](/packages/db/observers): Model lifecycle events (`creating`, `created`, `updated`, `deleted`, `restored`, `retrieved`), `@Observe()` decorator
- [DB Facade](/packages/db/facade): Raw `select`/`insert`/`update`/`delete`, fluent table queries, transactions, MongoDB collections

## Router — `@lara-node/router`

- [Overview](/packages/router): Fluent route builder, controller decorators, route groups, model binding, resource routing, OpenAPI
- [Basic Routing](/packages/router/basic): HTTP verbs, parameters, named routes, constraints, redirects, fallback
- [Route Groups](/packages/router/groups): Shared prefix, middleware, naming, nesting, `withoutMiddleware`
- [Controllers](/packages/router/controllers): `@Route()` class decorator, method decorators, middleware on classes/methods, registering controllers
- [Middleware](/packages/router/middleware): Route-level middleware, parameters, group middleware, registering aliases via `MiddlewareServiceProvider`
- [Route Model Binding](/packages/router/model-binding): `@Bind()` decorator, automatic model resolution, custom resolution callbacks
- [Resource Routes](/packages/router/resource): `Route.resource()` and `Route.apiResource()` — RESTful route generation
- [OpenAPI Generation](/packages/router/openapi): `@Doc()` decorator, `OpenApiGenerator`, `RouteScanner`, serving the spec

## Auth — `@lara-node/auth`

- [Overview](/packages/auth): JWT generation/verification, bcrypt password hashing, auth middleware, AES-256-GCM token encryption
- [Token Generation](/packages/auth/tokens): `generateToken(payload, ttl)`, `verifyToken(token)`, integration with login flow
- [Password Hashing](/packages/auth/passwords): `hashPassword()`, `comparePassword()`, hashing automatically via observers
- [Auth Middleware](/packages/auth/middleware): `authMiddleware`, `req.user` injection, `userLoader` option
- [Token Encryption](/packages/auth/encryption): `encryptToken()`/`decryptToken()` using `APP_KEY` — reset tokens, email verification

## Validator — `@lara-node/validator`

- [Overview](/packages/validator): `validate()` function, `ValidationError`, 50+ rules, type coercion, dot-notation, wildcards
- [Basic Usage](/packages/validator/basic): Pipe-separated rules, parameters, array/nested validation, `nullable`/`sometimes`, error handling
- [Validation Rules](/packages/validator/rules): String, numeric, type, format, date comparison, value, database (`unique`/`exists`), conditional, file rules
- [Custom Rules](/packages/validator/custom-rules): Custom rule functions, `requiredIf`/`requiredUnless`, file/phone/credit-card/nested rules
- [Error Messages](/packages/validator/messages): Default messages, custom field/rule messages, `ValidationError` structure, Express integration

## Cache — `@lara-node/cache`

- [Overview](/packages/cache): `Cache` facade — `set`/`get`/`del`/`has`/`remember`, rate limiting, Telescope integration
- [Cache Drivers](/packages/cache/drivers): `file`, `database`, `redis` drivers via `CACHE_DRIVER`, `generateCacheKey`, `cacheDelPrefix`
- [Rate Limiting](/packages/cache/rate-limiting): `RateLimiter.tooManyAttempts`/`hit`/`attempt`/`clear`, named limiters, throttle middleware

## Queue — `@lara-node/queue`

- [Overview](/packages/queue): Jobs, workers, scheduler, `sync`/`database`/`redis` drivers, failed job tracking
- [Jobs](/packages/queue/jobs): `@Queueable()`, `dispatch().onQueue().withDelay().withTries()`, lifecycle (`handle`, `failed`, `middleware`, `tags`), unique/encrypted jobs
- [Workers](/packages/queue/workers): `queue:work` command, options (`--delay`/`--memory`/`--timeout`/`--sleep`/`--tries`), worker events, programmatic control
- [Scheduler](/packages/queue/scheduler): `scheduler.command()`/`.job()`/`.call()`/`.exec()`, frequencies, constraints (weekdays, between, when), `onOneServer`
- [Failed Jobs](/packages/queue/failed-jobs): `queue:retry`/`queue:forget`/`queue:flush-failed`, `failed()` callback, `retryUntil()`

## Events — `@lara-node/events`

- [Overview](/packages/events): Event dispatcher, listeners, subscribers, queueable listeners, transaction-aware events, WebSocket broadcasting
- [Listeners](/packages/events/listeners): `@ListensTo()` decorator, multiple listeners, manual `on`/`once`/`off`, `@EventName()`
- [Subscribers](/packages/events/subscribers): `@Subscriber()` decorator, `on<EventName>` method naming, grouping related listeners
- [Queueable Listeners](/packages/events/queueable): `@ShouldQueue()` for async, queue/connection/tries/timeout options, `@AfterCommit()`
- [Broadcasting](/packages/events/broadcasting): `PublicChannel`/`PrivateChannel`/`PresenceChannel`, `@ShouldBroadcast()`, `@BroadcastAs()`, `Broadcast` facade

## Mail — `@lara-node/mail`

- [Overview](/packages/mail): `Mail` facade, `MailManager`, `Mailable` classes, SMTP/log/array/failover drivers, queue support
- [Mailables](/packages/mail/mailables): Building emails with fluent `.to()`/`.cc()`/`.subject()`/`.html()`/`.view()`/`.attach()`, `TextMailable`/`HtmlMailable`
- [Mail Drivers](/packages/mail/drivers): SMTP via Nodemailer, log driver for development, array driver for testing, failover chains
- [Queued Mail](/packages/mail/queued): `queueMail()`, `Mail.later()`, queue/delay properties on Mailables

## Middlewares — `@lara-node/middlewares`

- [Overview](/packages/middlewares): Pre-built middleware for auth, logging, validation, error handling, response extension, async context
- [Built-in Middleware](/packages/middlewares/built-in): `AuthMiddleware`, `RequestLoggerMiddleware`, `ValidatorMiddleware`, `ResponseExtenderMiddleware`, `ErrorHandlerMiddleware`, `AsyncContextMiddleware`
- [Auth & Authorization](/packages/middlewares/auth): `AuthMiddleware`, `AuthorizeByStatusMiddleware`, `authorizeRoles(...)`, `authorizePermissions(...)`

## Carbon — `@lara-node/carbon`

- [Overview](/packages/carbon): Laravel Carbon-inspired date library, immutable by default, fluent API, zero dependencies
- [Creating Dates](/packages/carbon/creating): `Carbon.current()`, `from(string)`, `fromTimestamp`, `fromFormat`, `min`/`max`, `today`/`tomorrow`/`yesterday`
- [Manipulation](/packages/carbon/manipulation): Accessors, `startOf*`/`endOf*`, `addDays`/`subMonths`, navigation
- [Formatting](/packages/carbon/formatting): Format tokens (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`), human-readable `diffForHumans()`
- [Comparison](/packages/carbon/comparison): `isPast`/`isFuture`/`isToday`/`isWeekend`/`isLeapYear`/`isBetween`, `diffInDays`/`diffInHours`
- [Intervals & Periods](/packages/carbon/intervals): `CarbonInterval` for durations, `CarbonPeriod` for iterating date ranges

## Console — `@lara-node/console`

- [Overview](/packages/console): Laravel Artisan-style CLI kernel, 40+ built-in commands, custom commands, scheduler integration
- [Writing Commands](/packages/console/commands): `Command` base class, signature, arguments/options, output methods, tables, interactive prompts
- [Built-in Commands](/packages/console/built-in): `serve`, `migrate*`, `db:*`, `cache:*`, `queue:*`, `horizon:*`, `event:*`, `route:list`, `key:generate`, `vendor:publish`

## Horizon — `@lara-node/horizon`

- [Overview](/packages/horizon): Queue monitoring dashboard at `/horizon`, worker management, metrics, failed jobs, scheduler tasks
- [Configuration](/packages/horizon/configuration): Per-environment supervisor settings, worker definitions (connection, queue, tries, timeout)
- [Dashboard](/packages/horizon/dashboard): `HorizonManager` API to start/pause/resume/stop workers, queue and failed job management

## Telescope — `@lara-node/telescope`

- [Overview](/packages/telescope): Debug dashboard at `/telescope` for requests, queries, exceptions, cache, jobs, schedule, logs
- [Configuration](/packages/telescope/configuration): `path`, `enabled`, `maxEntries`, `pruneHours`, disabling in production
- [Watchers](/packages/telescope/watchers): `QueryWatcher`, `CacheWatcher`, entry types, `TelescopeStore.record()`/`getEntries()`, metric buckets

## Exports — `@lara-node/exports`

- [Overview](/packages/exports): PDF/Excel/CSV generation — `toPDF()`, `toPDFFromTemplate()`, `toExcel()`, `toCSV()`, custom template delimiters

## CLI Tools

- [create-laranode](/cli/create-laranode): `pnpm create lara-node my-app` scaffold — generates models, controllers, services, providers, sample middleware
